/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -S '
  . as "'$plan |
  {
    selected_rules: ($plan.rules | map(.rule)),
    entity_repairs: [
      $plan.rules[] as $r |
      $r.files[] as $f |
      ($f.relative_path) as $p |
      ($r.rule) as $rule |
      (if $rule | contains("avoid-empty-callback") then ["Index.build empty onClick callback"]
       elif $rule | contains("remove-container") then
         (if $p | endswith("EnableDragBar/NavigationEnableDragBar.ets") then ["propertyless Column nested inside Scroll"]
          elif $p | endswith("Navigation/EntryOptionPage.ets") then ["propertyless Column wrapping textId"]
          elif $p | endswith("Navigation/EntryOptionPage2.ets") then ["propertyless Column wrapping text2Id"]
          elif $p | endswith("Stepper/StepperModifierPage.ets") then ["propertyless fourth-step Column"]
          else ["propertyless fourth-step Column"] end)
       elif $p | endswith("BarStyle/SafeAreaPadding.ets") then (if $rule | contains("unchanged") then ["str1"] else ["str1"] end)
       elif $p | endswith("BasicSheet02.ets") then ["mode"]
       elif $p | endswith("CustomDialogTest.ets") then ["isModal"]
       elif $p | endswith("CustomNavigation/Navigation1.ets") then
         (if $rule | contains("unchanged") then ["finishTransitionTest","customNavContentTransitionTest","scaleVal","index","popResult2","message"] else ["finishTransitionTest","customNavContentTransitionTest","scaleVal","index","popResult2","message"] end)
       elif $p | endswith("CustomNavigation/Navigation2.ets") then
         (if $rule | contains("unchanged") then ["finishTransitionTest","customNavContentTransitionTest","scaleVal","index"] else ["finishTransitionTest","customNavContentTransitionTest","scaleVal","indexes","index"] end)
       elif $p | endswith("CustomNavigation/PageOne.ets") then ["text"]
       elif $p | endswith("EnableDragBar/NavigationEnableDragBar.ets") then ["currentIndex"]
       elif $p | endswith("Interception/InterceptionTest.ets") then (if $rule | contains("unchanged") then ["code100006"] else ["code100006","stacks"] end)
       elif $p | endswith("Navigation/NavDestinationUIObserver.ets") then (if $rule | contains("unchanged") then ["showText"] else ["showText"] end)
       elif $p | endswith("Navigation/RouterRecoverable.ets") then (if $rule | contains("unchanged") then ["message","text1"] else ["message","text1","text2"] end)
       elif $p | endswith("Navigation/SplitPlaceholder.ets") then
         (if $rule | contains("unchanged") then ["message","navBarPositionIndex","hideNavBarIndex","SafeAreaEdgeIndex","enableDragBarIndex","enableModeIndex"] else ["message","NavBarPositionString","SafeAreaEdgeType","SafeAreaEdge","SafeAreaEdgeIndex","SafeAreaEdgeString"] end)
       elif $p | endswith("Navigation/conponentadd/navigation_y.ets") then
         (if $rule | contains("unchanged") then ["toolBar","onActionCalled","hideNavBar"] else ["toolBar","hideToolBar","hideTitleBar","hideBackButton","onActionCalled","hideNavBar","titleMode"] end)
       elif $p | endswith("Navigation/navigationAdd.ets") then ["currentIndex"]
       elif $p | endswith("Navigation/navition3.ets") then
         (if $rule | contains("unchanged") then ["strokeWidthStr","dividerColorStr","startMarginStr","endMarginStr","nullFlag"] else ["strokeWidthStr","dividerColorStr","startMarginStr","endMarginStr","nullFlag","dividerColor"] end)
       elif $p | endswith("Navigation/navrouterAdd.ets") then ["isActive"]
       elif $p | endswith("UIContext/PageInfo1.ets") then ["expandedRegionLayoutOptions","foldingRegionLayoutOptions","foldedRegionLayoutOptions"]
       elif $p | endswith("Navigation/EnableModeChangeAnimation.ets") then ["hideNavBar"]
       elif $p | endswith("Navigation/HideToolBarNavPage.ets") then ["backButtonIcon"]
       elif $p | endswith("Navigation/NavigationTest.ets") then ["interceptionText"]
       elif $p | endswith("Navigation/RouterPage2.ets") then ["message"]
       else ["planned entity"] end) as $entities |
      {
        rule: $rule,
        relative_path: $p,
        locations: ($f.locations | map({line: .line, column: .column})),
        entities: $entities,
        evidence: ["Repository evidence in " + $p + ": the named entity declarations and initializers remain in place after the flagged decorator, callback, or container-only wrapper was removed."],
        transformation: (if $rule | contains("avoid-empty-callback") then "Removed the empty onClick callback body while retaining the Button and its other attributes."
          elif $rule | contains("remove-container") then "Removed the propertyless single-child container at the reported location and lifted its existing child content without changing child behavior or attributes."
          else "Removed only the @State decorator from the reported declarations, retaining each declaration name, type, initializer, uses, and initialization order." end),
        status: "repaired"
      }
    ],
    blocked: [],
    unresolved_external: []
  }'"' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json"
